column1: # Sortable.a()/b(): GameScreen's draw dispatch is the reader -
#   while ((s = ci.poll()) != null) { if (s.a()) drawSite((Site)s); else if (s.b())
#   and the three implementations return constants (Site true/false, Unit false/false,
#   PositionedSortable false/true for the move-target proxy). So -> isSite / isMoveTargetMarker.
# Unit selectors, each pinned by exactly one reader:
#   H()/a(boolean): UnitCommander's canToggleHostedAuto/toggleHostedAuto toggle it around
#     canCarryAircraft(), and WorldSimulator launches getSubUnits() when it is set -> isHostedAuto.
#   E()/e(int): WorldSimulator's kill branch does kills = unit.E() + 1; unit.e(kills) and promotes
#   F()/f(int): the same branch switches on it for damage dealt/received and GameScreen draws a
#   L()/g(int): WorldSimulator picks RALLY_SPREADS[L() % len] and stores L()+1 -> the rally
#   B(): position.getUnit() == null || (health == 1000 && (!flying || progress == altitude)) - true
#     while the unit is not attached and (for produced/launching units) still incomplete; every
#     reader uses it as "this unit is out on the map and done" (UnitCommander refuses orders,
#     BuildingPanel/CarrierUnitPanel hide the production overlay) -> isDeployed.
#   v()/b(float): WorldSimulator accumulates the movement step into it (unit.b(unit.v() + step))
#     and GameScreen passes it as the progress argument of getProgressRegion -> getMoveProgress.
# UnitList.a(int) writes the id counter read by getNextId -> setNextId.
# ProjectileList.a() clears every contained projectile -> clearAll (ArrayList.clear is taken).
# BirdType.a() is multiplied by the frame delta to move the bird -> getSpeed.
# UnitType: E() returns the flag that is true only for the supply truck in DsfRuleset and is read
#   exactly where trucks are counted (EscortMode) or selected (InitTruckPlan) -> isTruck ;
#   F() is the loop radius World.revealFog walks around a unit -> getVisionRadiusInTiles.
# MapTemplatePainter.a(x, y, rows): paints one template block (corner land, sites and the units it
#   spawns) and returns them -> paintTemplate (the synthetic static forwards to it).
# Deliberately unnamed: UnitType.r() (only reader is a standoff branch in WorldSimulator; no name
# is forced by evidence), Player.c()/o() (write-only in the save path, o() only compared against
# game time by AIPlanner), UnitType/BirdType remaining letters.
